# Russian names of towns of 100,000 people or more

Pack 1.0.0. Every town of 100,000 people or more that the header shows as itself, with its Russian name and where it comes from: an override (places/curation/places-overrides.tsv), the Wikidata label of the town's item (used only when the item's English label is the town's name and the Russian label is no district, agglomeration or "old" quarter), GeoNames' preferred Russian name, or GeoNames' only Russian name (two different ones are a guess: none, the Latin name shows). To change a name, add an override.

5668 towns; without a Russian name: 0.
